query: select distinct cve.id as cve, min(10, round(cve.impactScore + cve.exploitabilityScore, 1)) as score, date(cve.publishedDate / 1000, 'unixepoch') as published, cve.description from Application a join Software s on s.id = a.software join vulnerability v on v.vendor = s.vendor and v.software = s.name join cve on cve.id = v.cve where s.id <> 'linux_kernel' and a.id = ${app} order by 2 desc
